signature: SUBROUTINE DLAQGB( M, N, KL, KU, AB, LDAB, R, C, ROWCND, COLCND,

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference:
On entry, the matrix A in band storage, in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: `AB(ku+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{ku}) \le i \le \min (m,j+\mathrm{kl})$

On exit, the equilibrated matrix, in the same storage format as A. See `EQUED` for the form of the equilibrated matrix.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: r
params.reference: The row scale factors for A.

params.name: c
params.reference: The column scale factors for A.

params.name: rowcnd
params.reference: Ratio of the smallest `R(i)` to the largest `R(i)`.

params.name: colcnd
params.reference: Ratio of the smallest `C(i)` to the largest `C(i)`.

params.name: amax
params.reference: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.

params.name: equed
params.reference:
Specifies the form of equilibration that was done.

-   `= 'N'`: No equilibration
-   `= 'R'`: Row equilibration, i.e., A has been premultiplied by diag(R).
-   `= 'C'`: Column equilibration, i.e., A has been postmultiplied by diag(C).
-   `= 'B'`: Both row and column equilibration, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(R) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(C)$.
